description: A serene, symmetrically composed bedroom centered on a handsome cane-panel headboard in warm medium walnut-toned wood framing a panel of fine woven rattan. The bed is dressed in layers of natural linen bedding — cream base sheets, caramel and sand-toned throw pillows, a thin grey woven plaid blanket draped across the foot. A low cream upholstered bench or settee sits at the foot of the bed in the foreground, with a soft throw draped over one arm. The walls are smooth plaster in a warm sandy greige tone. The ceiling is white horizontal shiplap planking running the width of the room. Two identical single-hung windows flank the headboard symmetrically, with views into bright leafy green trees beyond. Roman blinds in a natural linen stripe pattern hang at each window, partially lowered. The hardwood floor is a warm light oak tone. Two dark espresso-painted wood nightstands flank the bed — the left holds a small green potted plant and a matte ceramic bowl; the right holds a slender ceramic vase with dried wheat stems and a small rounded vase beside it. Soft diffused natural daylight floods in from both windows, filling the room with even, gentle illumination. A large spherical woven fabric globe-form hangs centrally from the shiplap ceiling, emitting a diffuse warm white glow that softly pools over the bed below. Camera at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition facing directly into the headboard wall, normal-to-wide lens capturing the full bed, nightstands, and both windows.
